hover-attack.interruption: May yield to grab or fall; runtime wiring is a separate slice.

fish-wait.interruption: May yield to grab/fall or scene cancellation. Separate runtime wiring required.

skyline.compositing: Opaque, static near-black 3024x800 bottom strip. Separate skylineLights overlays; no full-skyline pulsing.

ledge.compositing: Static opaque black/slate parapet below topLine; transparent above. Draw over the skyline and behind Kestrel, aligning per-cel supportAnchors with its top line. Seated legs hang in front. Repeat at native resolution, then scale once. No flashing or palette glow.

fishingCompositing: Draw behind body from the current rod-tip anchor; repeat 16x64 raster segment vertically at native resolution, crop last tile, then scale once with body. Place bobber attachment [32,17] at line end. Do not stretch the line tile. Cast length factors [0,0,0,0.6,0.8,1]; reel [1,0.65,0.3,0,0,0]; wait adds [0,2,4,1,-1,0] physical px. Fish-reel cels 4-6 include the short catch line and fish, so disable extended line there. Preserve neutral silver-grey line; bobber accent matches palette.
